Yes, Cloudflare's Agents SDK now supports AI SDK v7. The change shipped around July 23, 2026, and it covers the `agents`, `@cloudflare/ai-chat`, `@cloudflare/codemode`, and `@cloudflare/think` packages.

- **Version support:** The packages accept both `ai@^6` and `ai@^7`, with `@ai-sdk/react` at `^3` or `^4`. Use matching major versions: pair AI SDK v6 with @ai-sdk/react v3, or pair AI SDK v7 with @ai-sdk/react v4.
- **Migration:** Existing v6 apps don't have to upgrade. Moving to v7 doesn't require changing the Cloudflare Agents APIs you use.
- **Known limitations:** Per the agents@0.19.0 release notes, workers-ai-provider (Think's default model provider) is fixed at v4 for AI SDK v7. Consumers on ai@6 who rely on Think's built-in default model may hit a provider-version mismatch; passing their own LanguageModel avoids this. The same notes say chat@4.31.0 currently declares an ai@^6 peer and does not yet advertise v7 support; tracked separately.
- **Scope:** The release only covers current implementations. Newer AI SDK v7 APIs and optimizations are not included.

Sources: the Cloudflare changelog entry (developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-07-23-ai-sdk-v6-v7-support/) and the agents@0.19.0 release notes on newreleases.io. The release notes come from a third-party aggregator, so the Cloudflare changelog is the more authoritative source.

content.text:
Yes. Cloudflare added AI SDK v7 support on July 23, 2026 (from agents@0.19.0) across `agents`, `@cloudflare/ai-chat`, `@cloudflare/codemode` and `@cloudflare/think`. The current `agents` release (0.28.0) lists `ai` as an optional peer dependency at `^6.0.0 || ^7.0.0`, so v6 and v7 both work, and you don't need to change any Agents API calls to switch. Keep the majors matched: use `ai@7` with `@ai-sdk/react@4`, or `ai@6` with `@ai-sdk/react@3`.

There are two caveats in the release notes. Think's default model provider, `workers-ai-provider`, is pinned to the v7 line. If you stay on `ai@6` and rely on that default model, pass your own `LanguageModel`. Also, `chat@4.31.0` only declared an `ai@^6` peer when that release came out.

Sources:
- [Cloudflare changelog: Agents SDK packages support AI SDK v6 and v7](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-07-23-ai-sdk-v6-v7-support/)
- [agents@0.19.0 release notes](https://newreleases.io/project/github/cloudflare/agents/release/agents@0.19.0)
- [npm registry: agents@latest](https://registry.npmjs.org/agents/latest)
